summary: World action models (WAMs) learn latent variables from observations and use these to both predict the evolution of the scene and to generate actions. The prediction has to be of the whole scene, whereas only a portion of the scene causes actions.
takeaways: We therefore propose CWAM (Causal WAM), which incorporates the constraint into a pretrained WAM by adding a sparse routing path to its action head, with the world modeling objective remaining unchanged.
The prediction has to be of the whole scene, whereas only a portion of the scene causes actions.
We therefore separate out what causes action from what prediction depends on.
